messages:
alex: Heads up — I'm putting together a short proposal to add a 'service account / impersonation' pane in the Permissions UI. Goal: let customers grant short-lived tokens to automation without giving full org roles. Sketch attached. Key UX Qs: how do we show scope (route-level vs tenant-level), quota controls, and enterprise auditability (who created / last used)?

maria: +1. big ask from a couple enterprise customers. Also: if impersonated calls bypass quotas or routing policies we must expose controls. :warning:

tao: Important: telemetry/billing must attribute to originating tenant + SA usage. We can't lose the original principal in logs. Prefer SA issues short-lived JWTs so we map token->sa->owner.

jen: UX idea: 'Create service account' modal with fields: name, description, allowed scopes (checkbox tree: API routes / models / console actions), max qps, token ttl (max 24h), audit email. Also a preview pane that simulates "who can do what".

alex: Draft policy snippet example to discuss backend shape:
```json
{
  "name": "ci-deploy-bot",
  "scopes": ["inference:route:predict","model:read"],
  "quota": {"max_rps": 50},
  "ttl": 3600
}
```

maria: Question: is SA just sugar on top of existing API keys or a distinct object? We need rotation, KMS, and enterprise revoke across Dedicated clusters.

tao: Prefer distinct SA object that mints short tokens. Easier rotation and keyless operation (rotate underlying keys without forcing users to update infra). Backend tasks: SA table, token service, map to existing RBAC checks at request-time.

rbac-bot: Note: current RBAC enforcement is 'request-time role check'. Implementation must translate SA -> policy -> role checks. Add unit tests for per-route policy expansion.

jen: On the console flow: add 'simulate as' in role picker so admins can preview what an SA would access (renders routes, quota impacts, and show which sensitive routes are blocked). Also surface 'last used' and active tokens with revoke button.

alex: Good. Also consider integration with routing policies: e.g., SA can be restricted to particular regions or capacity tiers to control cost. Could tag SA with preferred routing policy.

maria: Enterprise asks for an "entitlements inheritance" opt-out for SA — some customers want SAs to inherit team-wide roles, others want strict isolation. Legal also requests audit trails and exportable CSV of SA usage.

tao: Rollout thoughts: implement hosted first behind FF; Dedicated needs cross-region sync; Private needs local KMS integration. Estimate ~6 sprints for end-to-end (API + token svc + console + telemetry).

jen: Telemetry plan: events sa.create, sa.token.issue, sa.token.revoke, sa.impersonation.request, sa.simulation.run. Add sampling for high-volume calls. Hook into Console dashboards: SA usage per-route, cost estimate.

alex: I'll draft an RFC + mockups by EOD tomorrow. Want volunteers to pair on API surface and enforcement mapping.

maria: I can take API design and revocation semantics.

tao: I'll do token service and telemetry schema.

jen: I'll prototype the simulate UI and mock quota preview.

alex: Thanks all. tagging follow ups: @maria @tao @jen.

audit-bot: audit: sa.create by alex at 1832101290 (created draft object, not yet provisioned).
